This is a pure, non-visual parser/formatter/symbol utility: no JSX, no DOM, no React, no Recharts/Leaflet/react-leaflet, and no old web-UI import anywhere. The arithmetic + suffix-stripping logic uses only String/Number/Math primitives, and the one runtime API (Intl.NumberFormat.format / .formatToParts) behaves identically under Hermes (React Native) and Node (Jest) — the same Intl surface the native dateFormat/timezone ports already rely on — so no DOM shim or 'unavailable' fallback state is required.
